situation: My manager Jordan Slacks me on weekends with 'quick questions'. I want to stop answering until Monday without it hurting my review.
reply: Hi Jordan, I want to be useful when you need me, and I also want to protect my weekends so I'm sharp on Monday. From now on I'll be offline on Slack on Saturdays and Sundays and I'll pick everything up first thing Monday. If something is truly urgent, call my phone and I'll answer.
note: The boundary is what you will do, with a real channel for emergencies, so it reads as reliable rather than unavailable.

situation: 每次家庭聚会，我大姨都当着所有人的面问我什么时候结婚、一个月挣多少。我28岁，想提前私下跟她说清楚。
reply: 大姨，我知道您是关心我。结婚和工资这两件事，我不打算在饭桌上聊，下次问起我就换个话题。别的事您想聊什么，我都陪您。
note: 说的是"我会怎么做"，不是"您不许问"；她再问时，就照说的换话题。

situation: Told my best friend I can't do 1am phone calls about her ex anymore and offered to call on weekends. She replied 'wow, I thought you were my best friend, after everything I've done for you.'
reply: I know you're upset, and I love you. I'm still here for you, just not at 1am. I'll call you Saturday morning.
note: Pushback means repeat it shorter, with no new reasons. Then call on Saturday as promised.

situation: Ma petite sœur Léa me demande de l'argent pour la troisième fois cette année, cette fois 400 euros pour son loyer. Je l'aime mais je ne veux plus prêter, les deux premières fois ne sont jamais revenues.
reply: Léa, je t'aime et je veux t'aider, vraiment. Mais je ne prête plus d'argent, à personne, c'est une décision ferme de mon côté. Par contre, si tu veux, on regarde ton budget ensemble ce week-end et on cherche ce qui peut se débloquer pour le loyer.
note: Pas de reproche sur les deux prêts précédents : la limite porte sur ce que tu fais, et l'aide proposée est réelle. Si elle insiste, répète la même phrase, plus courte.

situation: My mother-in-law, Linda, has a spare key and lets herself into our house 'just to drop things off', sometimes while we're still in bed. My husband agrees it has to stop. I want to text her kindly.
reply: Hi Linda, we love having you close by and the kids adore seeing so much of you. From now on we're going to keep the door latched from the inside when we're home, so the key won't open it. Text before you come over and we'll let you in, or leave things on the porch bench. You're still our emergency key holder.
note: The boundary is what you will do with the door, not a rule for her. If she pushes back, repeat the same line shorter: text first and we'll open up.
